releaseNotes:
What's New in Version 2.9.3 🚀
1. Improved UI: Refined Light theme styling across the entire app with crisp borders, rich emerald goal badges, fully visible activity heatmap grid, and high-contrast segmented controls. Added dedicated pure White Background & Black Timer toggle for Pomodoro.
2. Fixed Minor Bugs: Fixed calendar view checkmarks and goal completion indicators on white cards, Pomodoro focus/break button transitions, subject button contrast, and full-screen notification bar contrast.
3. Added Stability: Improved background timer execution, alarm scheduling, local storage caching, and Google Cloud sync resilience.
